title: An idea becomes a connected system — cel animation study

scenes.title: Idea on the night rooftop
scenes.purpose: Establish the fixed night-rooftop background plate and the character cel thinking, then the eureka moment as the idea bulb lights up.
visuals: BG-01 fixed flat-band night sky, moon, skyline silhouettes, water tower, parapet and roof floor
CEL-A character drawings: think, anticipation squash, eureka
Bulb cel with flat translucent glow cel and drawn spark ticks and motion arcs
assets: procedural PixiJS Graphics drawings (no external images)

beats.development: Thinking pose held with thought dots; headline line 1 wipes on in 6 drawn steps from 0.1s to 0.6s.
captions: BG-01 fixed · CEL-A char · digital cel simulation

beats.development: Anticipation squash drawing at 0.6s, then a swap to the eureka drawing at 0.8s. The bulb cel and glow cel pop in over 3 drawings; spark ticks and motion arcs show.

scenes.title: The system connects
scenes.purpose: The idea's linework draws out across the sky to five node cels, forming a connected system; the character presents it and the second headline line lands.
visuals: Light linework on twos from the bulb to the nodes
Five node cels popping in 3 drawings as each line arrives

beats.development: The network draws in 14 drawings over 0.9s. Nodes pop at 1.27s, 1.5s and 1.73s. The sparks clear at 1.3s.
Swap to the proud presenting drawing. Headline line 2, 'a connected system', wipes on in 7 steps from 2.0s to 2.45s.
The full scene holds, settled and readable.
captions: BG-01 fixed · CEL-A char · digital cel simulation

findings: All motion settles by 2.45s, before the 2.7s readability target.
Character action uses held exposures (0.6s, 0.2s, 1.15s, 1.05s), not tweened in-betweens, in keeping with cel cadence.
justifiedHolds: The 0.55s final hold gives time to read the complete headline and the connected network.

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects or voice.
Digital simulation of a cel-animation treatment; no physical cels were photographed.

Night-rooftop background chosen from the scene-dependent background policy and source-frame lessons (locked layered set, flat fills, one glowing focal prop, stroke-based motion marks). The source subject, characters and branding are not copied.
